changesApplied.changeMade: Replaced db.create() with SQL INSERT pattern. Added 'Z' suffix to timestamps for ISO 8601 compliance. Implemented multi-format result parsing with fallback response construction.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces specification requirement for problem data persistence. The db.create() method doesn't persist records with SurrealDB HTTP client (systematic bug). SQL INSERT pattern proven to work in commits d61fa57 (user auth) and adb858a (project creation). Critical for metabob-cli → Dashboard problem data flow.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Direct callers: metabob-cli analyze command, analysis jobs. Downstream: Dashboard problem display, GET /projects/{id}/problems endpoint. Risk: LOW - Same pattern as working project_ops.py. Blast radius: Single function, well-isolated.

changesApplied.changeMade: Replaced db.insert() with SQL INSERT loop. Removed db.create() fallback. Implemented per-record SQL INSERT with result parsing. Added 'Z' suffix to timestamps. Better error handling with partial success (returns created records even if some fail).
changesApplied.reason: Enforces specification requirement for bulk problem insertion. The db.insert() method has same persistence bug as db.create(). Metabob-cli analysis jobs create multiple problems per file, making bulk insert critical for Dashboard data population. Loop pattern ensures each record persists correctly.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Direct callers: tasks/jobs/analysis.py (metabob-cli backend). Downstream: Dashboard problem counts, severity distribution, file grouping. Risk: MEDIUM - Loop pattern less efficient than batch INSERT but ensures persistence. Blast radius: Analysis job performance (may be slightly slower but correct). Trade-off: Correctness over performance (can optimize later with batch SQL INSERT).

changesApplied.changeMade: Created layered Dockerfile building on 0.28.2-final-auth-fix base image. Packages both project_ops.py (commit adb858a) and problem_ops.py (commit d5420bf) fixes. Includes deployment metadata for verification. Fast build (~2 seconds) using layered approach.
changesApplied.reason: Packages complete persistence fix for deployment to Kubernetes. Uses layered approach for fast builds without rebuilding entire base image. Includes deployment metadata showing commits, fixes applied, and timestamp. Ready for immediate deployment.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Deployment target: Kubernetes metabob namespace. Replaces: Previous version (likely 0.28.2 or earlier). Rollback: Can revert to 0.28.2-final-auth-fix base image if issues arise. Risk: LOW - Minimal code changes, same proven pattern as working authentication fix.
